gamerule.truesleep.engine_tps.descriptio: How hard the server works during sleep. Keep this LOW (40-60) for best performance. Higher values use more CPU but don't make night faster — use Time Speed for that. Default: 50.
gamerule.truesleep.virtual_tps.descripti: How fast the night flies by. Higher = faster. 1000 = 50x speed, 5000 = 250x speed. This is the main setting to change. Default: 1000.
gamerule.truesleep.sleep_threshold.descr: When players can start sleeping (in ticks). 0 = midnight, 6000 = noon, 12542 = sunset. Default: 12542.
gamerule.truesleep.wake_time.description: What time of day players wake up (in ticks). 0 = sunrise, 6000 = noon, 18000 = midnight. Default: 0 (sunrise).
gamerule.truesleep.drown_immunity.descri: Prevents players from drowning while sleeping. Turn off if you want risky underwater naps. Default: ON.
gamerule.truesleep.freeze_mobs.descripti: Pauses all mobs while sleeping so they don't wander or despawn. Turn off for chaos. Default: ON.
gamerule.truesleep.freeze_workers.descri: Also pauses villagers and iron golems while sleeping. Turn ON if villagers are causing lag during sleep. Default: OFF.
gamerule.truesleep.accelerate_machines.d: Speeds up furnaces, brewing stands, and modded machines during sleep to match the fast-forward speed. Default: ON.
gamerule.truesleep.accelerate_hoppers.de: Speeds up hoppers connected directly to smelting or brewing machines to feed them at matching speeds. Default: ON.
config.truesleep.title: True Sleep Configuration
config.truesleep.warning: Note: These options act as defaults for new worlds. For running worlds, use the /gamerule command.
